title: resample
body:
## resample

Samples the arrays of the input node (port input, native SourceDataArrays) at the points of the mesh node (port mesh, native DestinationMesh). The result has the mesh's geometry with the input's point and cell values interpolated to its points and a vtkValidPointMask array; with passPointArrays (Schemaxis default true) the mesh's own point arrays are kept too. Use it to compare or combine results on a common mesh, e.g. map a CFD field onto a measurement or structural mesh; pvResampleWithDataset exposes the remaining native settings.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The ports are easily swapped: input supplies the values, mesh supplies the geometry.
- Mesh points outside the input get vtkValidPointMask 0 and unusable values; threshold on the mask before statistics.

Native constructor: `ResampleWithDataset`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native SourceDataArrays port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the dataset from which to obtain probe values. The data attributes come from this dataset. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `mesh` | Required data input for the native DestinationMesh port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the dataset whose geometry will be used in determining positions to probe. The mesh comes from this dataset. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `passPointArrays` | Keeps the mesh node's own point arrays (native DestinationMesh) in the output next to the values sampled from the input node. When false, only the sampled arrays and vtkValidPointMask remain on the points. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `passCellArrays` | Keeps the mesh node's own cell arrays (native DestinationMesh) in the output. The input node's cell values are always sampled to the mesh points, never passed as cells. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |
| `categorical` | Control whether the source point data is to be treated as categorical. If the data is categorical, then the resultant data will be determined by a nearest neighbor interpolation scheme rather than by linear interpolation. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "resample",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input",
    "mesh": "UPSTREAM_mesh"
  }
}
```
